d:
BJP Meeting Patna : bihar ki rajdhani patna men BJP ki aham baithak bulaee gaee. baithak men parti ke pradesh prabhari harish dvivedi bhi shamil hue. MLC chunav ke natijon aur sangthan se jure muddon par charcha huee.
Vahin, RJD ne patna shikshak nirvachan sit aur darbhanga snatak nirvachan sit par BJP ki har ko lekar tanj kasa. RJD ke bayan par BJP aur JDU ne bhi palatvar kiya. dekhie bihar ki siyasat men is baithak aur bayanbaji se juri puri riporta.
